name: Verify a critical system design
short_description: Verify a complex system against interacting safety, security, consistency, performance, and recovery properties using independent evidence.
self_assessment: I can verify one critical system design without help using five independent property checks.
description: Verify a complex system against interacting safety, security, consistency, performance, and recovery properties using independent evidence. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Verify a replicated service under modeled failures

builds_on.note: Model validation supports independent challenge of system assumptions.

safety_note: Critical-system errors can cause widespread harm; use isolated tests, explicit authorization, independent review, and staged verification before any live change.
